names.PSK: The pre-shared uniformly random key that Party U and Party V are assumed to share, which Party V identifies by KID and which is the salt of the key derivation when EDHOC is authenticated with symmetric keys (§5.1, §3.2).
names.K_2: The key with which Party V encrypts COSE_ENC_2 of message_2 (AEAD_V with K_2 and IV_2), derived as in Section 3.2 (§3.2, §5.3.1, §5.3.2).
names.APP_2': The payload of K_2's second use outside the protocol, introduced by assumption sym_key_reuse_V (key_reuse of K_2, the message_2 key of §3.2); not defined by the document.
names.U: The principal U: EDHOC initiator in the pre-shared-key mode. Holds the PSK shared with V, sends message_1 with its ephemeral DH share and the PSK identifier, and derives the OSCORE master secret.
names.V: The principal V: EDHOC responder in the pre-shared-key mode. Holds the same PSK, answers with its own ephemeral share in message_2, and derives the same OSCORE master secret. No signature key is used in this mode.
names.E_U: The ECDH ephemeral public key of Party U, sent in data_1 of message_1 and formatted as a COSE_Key (§2, §3.1, §5.2.1).
names.E_V: The ECDH ephemeral public key of Party V, sent in data_2 of message_2 on the same curve as E_U (§2, §5.3.1, §5.3.2).
names.S_U: The variable-length session identifier chosen by Party U, not in use and different from other concurrent session identifiers, sent in message_1 and echoed in data_2 of message_2 (§2, §5.2.1, §5.2.2, §5.3.1).
names.S_V: The variable-length session identifier chosen by Party V, sent in message_2 and echoed in data_3 of message_3 (§2, §5.3.1, §5.3.2, §5.4.1).
names.N_U: The 64-bit random nonce chosen freshly by Party U for each session and sent in message_1 (§2, §5.2.1, §5.2.2).
names.N_V: The 64-bit random nonce chosen freshly by Party V for each session and sent in message_2 (§2, §5.3.1, §5.3.2).
names.ECDH_Curves_U: ECDH-Curves_U in message_1: the EC curves for ECDH that Party U supports, in order of decreasing preference (§5.2.1).
names.HKDFs_U: The list of ECDH-SS w/ HKDF algorithms Party U supports, proposed in message_1 (§5.2.1).
names.AEADs_U: The list of AEAD algorithms Party U supports, proposed in message_1 (§5.2.1).
names.HKDF_V: The single ECDH-SS w/ HKDF algorithm Party V chooses from HKDFs_U, sent in data_2 of message_2 and used for key derivation (§3.2, §5.3.1, §5.3.2).
names.AEAD_V: The single AEAD algorithm Party V chooses from AEADs_U, sent in data_2 of message_2 and used with K_2 and K_3 to compute COSE_ENC_2 and COSE_ENC_3 (§3.2, §5.3.1, §5.3.2, §5.4.2).
names.KID: The identifier of the pre-shared key PSK, sent in message_1, by which Party V identifies the PSK (§5.1, §5.2.1, §8).
names.APP_1: The opaque application data Party U may send unprotected in data_1 of message_1 (§3, §5.2.1).
names.APP_2: The opaque application data Party V sends as the plaintext of COSE_ENC_2 in message_2, encrypted and integrity protected under K_2 and, with symmetric keys, mutually authenticated (§3, §5.3.1, §5.3.2).
names.APP_3: The opaque application data Party U sends as the plaintext of COSE_ENC_3 in message_3, protected under K_3 and mutually authenticated (§3, §5.4.1, §5.4.2).
names.OSCORE_Master_Secret: The OSCORE Master Secret that Party U and Party V derive from EDHOC as specified in Section 3.2 with other = exchange_hash and AlgorithmID = "EDHOC OSCORE Master Secret" (§C.2, §3.2).
